name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 32) — Windows 11 dialogs.
• Help → About LitArbi shows which version is installed — x64 or ARM64, native or emulated — plus .NET and Windows version, with Copy Details for support.
• All messages and confirmations use the Windows 11 dialog style; no more Windows 95-looking boxes.
• Build 31: Windows 11 design throughout, native on ARM64 (the installer can install the ARM64 .NET 8 Desktop Runtime), snap layouts, Mica.
